channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dennis Schroeder | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dennis Schroeder from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Hannes Steinbach on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Sam Perley:Hannes Steinbach on playing with Dennis Schröder:

“It's great to have someone who can speak German. To play and learn from him is going to be great.”

Hannes Steinbach on Dennis Schroeder, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Daniel Theis on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Theis told Braunschweiger Zeitung.

“Everyone who knows Dennis knows what he’s like. I feel like he’ll play for the national team until he’s 40.”

Daniel Theis on Dennis Schroeder, Aug 22, 2026. Source: Sportando.

item.title: Koby Altman on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
During his time in Cleveland, Schröder appeared in 30 games, averaging 8.2 points, 4.3 assists and 2.3 rebounds while serving as the team’s primary backup point guard.

“Dennis made an immediate impact after joining us at the trade deadline, bringing experience, toughness, and leadership to our group,”

Koby Altman on Dennis Schroeder, Aug 21, 2026. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Draymond Green on Mike Dunleavy, Joe Lacob, Jimmy Butler, Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“I've also seen that Mike Dunleavy and Joe Lacob have gotten a lot of criticism for their lack of risk taking over the last few years, playing it for the post-Steph era. And listen, there's always going to be backlash when you're not winning. It happens to everyone. That's just what comes with the territory. But I don't think going to trade for Jimmy Butler would be considered lack of taking risks, especially signing him to a two-year $121 million extension. I don't think that would be considered a lack of taking risk. I also don't believe that trading for Dennis Schroeder, trying to make something happen, is a lack of taking risk.”

Draymond Green on Mike Dunleavy, Joe Lacob, Jimmy Butler, Dennis Schroeder, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
“Dennis is, how should I say, extremely competitive and maybe wasn’t aware of all the nuances of the NBA — or he just didn’t care,”

Kenny Atkinson on Dennis Schroeder, Apr 20, 2026. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Nicolas Batum on the comments under French players’ social media pages after win against Slovenia:

“Some of y’all are SICK even if you disagree with a BASKETBALL play, racism and hate are NEVER ACCEPTABLE at all. After Dennis Schroder earlier, now this…”

Nicolas Batum on Dennis Schroeder, Aug 31, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on Dennis Schroder:

“You need a guy who has courage, and this is what we envisioned when we made the trade for him, is him being in lineups where he can help us finish. He rose up to the occasion tonight.”

JB Bickerstaff on Dennis Schroeder, Feb 23, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
“You have a counter to aggressive defenses that want to take the ball out of my hands. It should help Dennis (Schröder) a little bit, too. Pick-and-roll type situations, make the defense decide whether to pull in or stay at home. Try to get downhill a little more. Try to create advantage off his presence or a shooter’s presence at the five. It definitely helps.”

Stephen Curry on Dennis Schroeder, Jan 23, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
“It’s a tough thing. Especially, when you’re coming to a team like this. Steph Curry, naturally, you’re going to fall back. But what we want Dennis to do is pull forward.”

Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Dennis Schroeder, Dec 26, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Mike Dunleavy on Draymond Green, Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Mike Dunleavy on Steph/Draymond's role in Dennis Schröder deal:

“Those guys are not banging down my door. They never do that... Do I keep them in the loop? Yes. Were they double thumbs up on this move? Yes... It's a good clean process. They're on board. Steve's on board.”

Mike Dunleavy on Draymond Green, Dennis Schroeder, Dec 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Mike Dunleavy on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Mike Dunleavy on Dennis Schröder (on an expiring $13 million deal):

“We still think he has a lot of good years left in him. We'll have his Bird rights, the ability to re-sign him. Hopefully there's a relationship here longer than just a few months.”

Mike Dunleavy on Dennis Schroeder, Dec 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jordi Fernandez on getting outscored 35-18 late:

“Its my fault. I ran Dennis 12 minutes in the 4th. I didn't give him a break. That's how your execution goes down; that's how your defense goes down. I didnt give Cam breaks. At the end we paid for it. So I have to be better”

Jordi Fernandez on Dennis Schroeder, Nov 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
“Dennis and Chris were the first ones to stay if they put you on the court, guard the best player full court. And I just developed this mentality to do that, which has helped.”

Luguentz Dort on Dennis Schroeder, Apr 29, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Darvin Ham on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Ham continued:

“It doesn’t hit the ground running all the time smooth. Trying to figure things out on the fly. And yeah, Dennis is someone I love and care about. Dennis is a helluva player. But just trying to learn Lo on the fly and figure things out.”

Darvin Ham on Dennis Schroeder, Mar 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Jacque Vaughn on Dennis Schroder's debut:

“He was able to show just his ability to be a point guard on the floor... Just the overall feel of understanding the flow of the game and what’s needed. The IQ piece, that’s gonna be very important for our group going forward.”

Jacque Vaughn on Dennis Schroeder, Feb 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Bobby Webster on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Bobby Webster:

“We were able to turn one of the picks into a good young player in Ochai and we got a steadying presence in Kelly. Financially, we were able to gain some more flexibility this summer with the Dennis trade. I think the heavy lifting was done this December-January and this deadline continued on that path, if that makes sense.”

Bobby Webster on Dennis Schroeder, Feb 8, 2024. Source: SportsNet.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Jacque Vaughn on Dennis Schroder:

“A guy that is going to compete on a nightly basis has the ability to get to the paint. Thinks like a point guard where it's sharing the basketball, getting the group set, getting downhill, but a guy who's won on a high level.”

Jacque Vaughn on Dennis Schroeder, Feb 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
USA coachSteve Kerr on Germany/Raptors guard Dennis Schroeder:

“I give Dennis Schroeder a ton of credit. I think he's a really tough guard to handle,he's quick, he can get the ball and penetrate constantly and that really threatens your defence and compromises the defence.”

Steve Kerr on Dennis Schroeder, Sep 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @vivekmjacob.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
“We’re excited to welcome Dennis to Toronto, and are looking forward to seeing him on the Scotiabank Arena court.”

Masai Ujiri on Dennis Schroeder, Jul 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
“I'm very interested. I've already talked to Dennis Schroder about it. A year ago, I had a lengthy conversation with the national team's coach Gordon Herbert. I really feel like it,”

Austin Reaves on Dennis Schroeder, Mar 24, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Anthony Davis on Dennis Schroder:

“He wants to get to the playoffs. He wants to win. So by any means, he's going to go out there & give it a go,& at this point in the season, I think everybody is playing w/ a little something. Hats off to him. He's been a huge part for us this entire season.”

Anthony Davis on Dennis Schroeder, Mar 5, 2023. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Rob Pelinka:

“Not only do Dennis and Coach Ham share a player-coach history together, but they also reflect one another’s mentality of toughness with an extremely competitive edge. Dennis will add both depth and an on-ball defensive presence to our core at the guard position. He is also a proven scorer and playmaker. We are really excited for Dennis to get to camp and get back to work in L.A. after his highly successful run with his national team this offseason.”

Rob Pelinka on Dennis Schroeder, Sep 16, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Darren Wolfson on Paul Millsap, Dennis Schroeder, Josh Hart, Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
“I can tell you the Wolves have kicked the tires on Paul Millsap, on Josh Hart, on Dennis Schroeder, on Lauri Markkanen,”

Darren Wolfson on Paul Millsap, Dennis Schroeder, Josh Hart, Lauri Markkanen, Aug 10, 2021. Source: ahnfiredigital.com.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
“He's hounding guys, picking up players full court, diving for loose balls, bringing that energy on the defensive end, and of course he has that ability to score at the point guard position. We value those qualities in him. August is August and free agency is a couple months away. There's a lot of different things we'll have to evaluate there, but Dennis is an attractive player to us just because of what he brings to the table.”

Rob Pelinka on Dennis Schroeder, Jun 5, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
“I think all of us can look at Dennis' body of work, and he is an extreme competitor, and that's on both sides of the ball,”

Rob Pelinka on Dennis Schroeder, Jun 5, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on if Dennis Schroder will play tmw:

“Decision on Dennis will be made tomorrow.... I thought it was a good start for DS for sure.”

Frank Vogel on Dennis Schroeder, May 15, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on Dennis Schroder being able to join the team on Saturday:

“It's still a possibility. That's all I can really say.... We're hopeful he's able to play in the Indiana game.”

Frank Vogel on Dennis Schroeder, May 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: LeBron James on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
LeBron postgame on this recent stretch:

“It’s a challenge for us, it’s a little adversity …obviously injuries, and AD being a huge piece of our team … Dennis being a big (piece)… but we’ll figure it out.”

LeBron James on Dennis Schroeder, Feb 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Thunder CoachMark Daigneault on Dennis Schroder:

“He’s a feisty ball of energy that’s truly engaged in competition … there’s not a possession where he’s not ready to compete… he has a very contageous energy. He’s not influenced by anything external - he (always) brings it.”

Mark Daigneault on Dennis Schroeder, Feb 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Lu Dort on guarding former OKC teammate Dennis Schroder:

“I learned a lot from Dennis last season. It'll be good to see him and compete against him. I know his game pretty well.”

Luguentz Dort on Dennis Schroeder, Jan 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.
